title: Constant confidence: ACK-leaning trigger inside PASS-leaning context must lower the winner's confidence
review: draft: converted from the V1 litmus corpus; V1 expected ACK or PASS. V1 rationale: The trigger explicitly requests acknowledgement (ACK support) while the context says a peer already covered it and the thread is resolved (PASS support). Whichever verdict wins must carry lower confidence than the clean unambiguous baseline in its verdict class (m-baseline-ack-broadcast / m-baseline-pass-adapter-resolved at the 0.85 baseline used by invariants.check_confidence_not_constant).
